$description: Crystal component catalogue, combined. Generated from core/tokens/catalogue/.

categories.name: Layout and structure
categories.description: Surfaces and arrangement. These carry Crystal's material hierarchy; everything else sits inside them.

components.name: App shell
components.anatomy: Plastic foundation, optional Frost sidebar and header, a content region, and a floating Resin destination group.
components.material: Plastic foundation; Frost supporting panels; Resin destination plane
components.geometry: Panel radius = content radius + 6px
components.semantics: Landmark roles: banner, navigation, main, contentinfo. One main per view.
components.crystal: Material assignment per region, elevation ordering, safe-area handling
components.product: Routing, which regions exist, persistence of the collapsed state

components.name: Container
components.anatomy: Max-width reading column with responsive gutters.
components.geometry: Gutters follow the 4px rhythm: 18/26/44px by viewport
components.semantics: Presentational only; must not introduce a landmark
components.crystal: Width ceiling and gutter scale

components.name: Grid
components.anatomy: Column grid with a consistent gutter and responsive column counts.
components.geometry: Gutters from the 4px rhythm; 12-column reference
components.semantics: Presentational; reading order must match visual order
components.crystal: Gutter scale and breakpoint behaviour

components.name: Simple grid
components.anatomy: Equal-width auto-flowing cells.
components.geometry: Shared gutter with Grid
components.semantics: Presentational
components.crystal: Minimum cell width and gutter

components.name: Stack
components.anatomy: Vertical arrangement with one spacing value between children.
components.geometry: Spacing from the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Presentational
components.crystal: Spacing scale

components.name: Group
components.anatomy: Horizontal arrangement with wrapping and alignment control.
components.geometry: Spacing from the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Presentational
components.crystal: Spacing scale and wrap behaviour

components.name: Divider
components.anatomy: A hairline rule, optionally with a centred or leading label.
components.material: Edge colour token; never a heavy rule
components.geometry: 1px, full-bleed within its container
components.semantics: role=separator with an accessible name when labelled; decorative dividers are aria-hidden
components.crystal: Rule colour and label treatment

components.name: Aspect ratio
components.anatomy: A box that reserves a fixed ratio before its content loads.
components.material: Inherits; commonly wraps Image or a media surface
components.geometry: Content radius when clipping media
components.semantics: Presentational
components.crystal: Reserving space so loading media does not shift layout

components.name: Scroll area
components.anatomy: A bounded scrolling region with a Crystal scrollbar and edge fades.
components.material: Inherits; edge fade uses the surrounding material
components.geometry: Inherits container radius; fade depth 24px
components.semantics: Keyboard scrollable; must be focusable when it is the only way to reach content
components.crystal: Scrollbar appearance, edge fade, reduced-motion behaviour

components.name: Center
components.anatomy: Centres a single child on both axes.
components.geometry: None
components.semantics: Presentational
components.crystal: Nothing beyond layout

components.name: Space
components.anatomy: An explicit gap from the spacing scale.
components.geometry: 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Presentational; never used to convey grouping to assistive technology
components.crystal: Spacing scale

components.name: App bar
components.anatomy: A Frost band across the top of a view, holding a title, navigation affordances and actions.
components.material: Frost band over the Plastic foundation
components.geometry: Full-bleed; no radius on the outer edges; actions are pills.
components.semantics: role="banner" unless nested; the title is the page heading or labels one.
components.crystal: Material, elevation on scroll, action geometry
components.product: Which actions appear, scroll behaviour, routing

components.name: Masonry
components.anatomy: A column layout that packs items of unequal height without stretching them.
components.material: None of its own; children carry material
components.geometry: Gap follows the spacing scale; columns respond to container width.
components.semantics: A list when the items are a set; otherwise presentational.
components.crystal: Spacing, breakpoint behaviour, reduced-motion reflow

components.name: Overflow list
components.anatomy: A single row that measures itself and moves what does not fit into a menu.
components.material: Children keep theirs; the overflow menu is Frost
components.geometry: Overflow trigger is a pill and reaches 44px.
components.semantics: The overflow trigger names how many items it holds; hidden items stay reachable.
components.crystal: Measurement, the trigger, the menu material

categories.name: Navigation
categories.description: Moving between destinations. Current location is a dot; selection within a set is label weight. Neither is ever a check mark.

components.name: Anchor
components.anatomy: Inline text link with an offset underline.
components.geometry: Underline offset 4px
components.semantics: Native anchor with an href. A link that acts is a button, not a link.
components.crystal: Colour, underline offset, focus ring

components.name: Nav link
components.anatomy: Pill-shaped destination with optional icon, label and current-location dot.
components.geometry: Pill; minimum 44px target
components.semantics: aria-current="page" for the active destination, never aria-selected
components.crystal: Material, pill geometry, current-location dot, focus ring
components.product: Routing and which destination is current

components.name: Navigation rail
components.anatomy: A vertical Frost panel of nav links, collapsible to icons.
components.geometry: Panel radius = content radius + 6px
components.semantics: nav landmark with an accessible name; collapsed items keep accessible names
components.crystal: Panel material, collapse geometry, active treatment

components.name: Destination dock
components.anatomy: One floating Resin plane holding labelled destinations on a shared Stone label group.
components.material: Resin plane, Stone label backing, primary fill on the selected destination
components.geometry: Pill; 52px minimum destination height
components.semantics: nav landmark; aria-pressed or aria-current on the destination
components.crystal: The single shared plane, label weight for the current entry, elevation
components.note: One plane, not three separate glass objects. This is an approved-baseline requirement.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.anatomy: Ordered trail of anchors with a separator, collapsing in the middle when space is short.
components.material: None; sits on the reading surface
components.geometry: Separator from the icon set; 44px targets on touch
components.semantics: nav landmark with an ordered list; aria-current="page" on the final crumb
components.crystal: Separator, collapse behaviour, current treatment

components.name: Tabs
components.anatomy: A Resin tab strip with a selected tab and an associated panel.
components.material: Resin strip, primary fill on the selected tab
components.geometry: Pill tabs inside a pill strip; 44px minimum
components.semantics: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with arrow-key, Home and End navigation and aria-selected
components.crystal: Strip material, label weight for the selected tab, focus ring
components.product: The roving tabindex implementation and panel content

components.name: Pagination
components.anatomy: Page controls with previous and next, numbered pills and an ellipsis for elided ranges.
components.geometry: Pill; 44px minimum target
components.semantics: nav landmark with an accessible name; aria-current="page" on the active page
components.crystal: Pill geometry, current treatment, elision rules
components.product: Page count, routing and the data fetch

components.name: Stepper
components.anatomy: Ordered steps with a connector, each showing its own completion state.
components.material: Resin step markers on a Haze track
components.geometry: Circular markers; connector 2px
components.semantics: Ordered list; the current step carries aria-current="step"; state is announced in text, not by colour
components.crystal: Marker geometry, connector, state treatment
components.product: Step validation and whether steps are navigable
components.note: A completed step may use a check mark: that is information display about validation, not a selection cue.

components.name: Burger
components.anatomy: An icon-only control that discloses navigation on narrow viewports.
components.geometry: Pill or circle; 44px minimum
components.semantics: button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, and a real accessible name
components.crystal: Material, geometry, the open/closed icon transition

components.name: Command palette
components.anatomy: A Mirage-backed overlay with a search field, grouped results and keyboard hints.
components.material: Mirage scrim, Haze decision surface, Resin field shell
components.geometry: Content radius; results list inset 8px
components.semantics: Modal dialog with a combobox; aria-activedescendant for the highlighted result
components.crystal: Overlay material, result row treatment, keyboard hint styling
components.product: The command registry, search, modality, focus containment and focus return

components.name: Tree view
components.anatomy: Nested disclosure rows with indentation guides and expand controls.
components.material: Haze rows on the surrounding surface
components.geometry: Indent step 20px; guides use the edge token
components.semantics: role=tree/treeitem/group with aria-expanded, aria-level and full arrow-key navigation
components.crystal: Row treatment, indentation guides, label weight for the selected row
components.product: The keyboard navigation implementation, data and lazy loading

components.name: Affix
components.anatomy: An element that pins to the viewport past a scroll threshold.
components.material: Resin once pinned, to separate it from the content it floats over
components.geometry: Inherits the pinned element's geometry
components.semantics: Must not cover the focused element or the final content
components.crystal: The material change on pin and the elevation it takes

components.name: Bottom navigation
components.anatomy: A Resin destination group pinned to the bottom of a narrow view.
components.material: Resin plane holding Haze label fills
components.geometry: Pill; targets at least 44px; respects the safe area.
components.semantics: role="navigation"; the current destination carries aria-current="page".
components.crystal: Material, geometry, selection by label weight, safe-area inset

components.name: Navigation menu
components.anatomy: A horizontal menu whose items open rich panels beneath them.
components.geometry: Panel radius = content radius + 6px.
components.semantics: Menubar semantics; arrow keys move between triggers, Escape closes.
components.crystal: Panel material, motion, focus handling

components.name: Table of contents
components.anatomy: A list of the headings in a document, marking the one in view.
components.geometry: Indentation follows heading depth; label weight marks the active entry.
components.semantics: role="navigation" with an accessible name; the active entry uses aria-current="location".
components.crystal: Active marking by label weight, spacing
components.product: Which headings are collected, scroll spy thresholds

components.name: Menubar
components.anatomy: A horizontal bar of menu triggers, each opening its own menu.
components.geometry: Triggers are pills; menus keep panel radius.
components.semantics: Menubar semantics: arrows move between triggers, Home and End jump, typeahead selects.
components.crystal: Materials, open and close motion, focus handling

components.name: Submenu
components.anatomy: A menu opened from an item inside another menu.
components.geometry: Offset from its parent item; flips at the viewport edge.
components.semantics: The parent item carries aria-haspopup and aria-expanded; the submenu is reachable by arrow key and closes with Escape without closing its parent.
components.crystal: Panel material, stagger, edge flipping

categories.name: Actions
categories.description: Controls that do something. All action geometry is a pill, independent of the content radius.

components.name: Button
components.anatomy: Resin shell, 8px-inset Haze reading fill, directional optical sheen, label and optional leading icon.
components.material: Resin shell with Haze fill; primary, secondary, quiet and danger variants
components.geometry: Pill (999px); 48px height; 15px/24px padding; 44px minimum target
components.semantics: Native button. A disabled button must not be the only explanation of unavailability.
components.crystal: Material, pill geometry, optical pressure, focus ring, variant hierarchy
components.product: The action itself, progress reporting and error recovery

components.name: Icon button
components.anatomy: Square-ratio Resin shell containing a single 24px icon.
components.geometry: Pill or circle; 44px minimum target regardless of icon size
components.semantics: Requires an accessible name; the icon itself is aria-hidden. Toggles use aria-pressed.
components.crystal: Material, geometry, target floor, focus ring
components.product: The action and the accessible name

components.name: Button group
components.anatomy: Adjacent actions sharing one Resin plane with internal hairlines.
components.material: One shared Resin plane, not one plane per button
components.geometry: Pill outer geometry; interior corners square against neighbours
components.semantics: group role with an accessible name when the buttons are related
components.crystal: The shared plane and interior separation

components.name: Split button
components.anatomy: A default action and an adjacent disclosure that opens related actions.
components.material: Shared Resin plane with a hairline between the two targets
components.geometry: Pill outer geometry; both halves meet the 44px floor independently
components.semantics: Two buttons; the disclosure carries aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="menu"
components.crystal: Shared plane, separation, menu material
components.product: The default action, the menu contents and menu keyboard behaviour

components.name: Floating action
components.anatomy: A persistent circular Resin action floating above content.
components.material: Resin with the clearest floating shadow
components.geometry: Circle, or pill when extended with a label
components.semantics: Requires an accessible name; must not cover the final content or the focused element
components.crystal: Material, elevation, extend behaviour, safe-area offset
components.product: The action and when it is present

components.name: Copy button
components.anatomy: An action that copies a value and confirms in place.
components.material: Resin shell; the confirmation is a transient label change
components.geometry: Pill; 44px minimum
components.semantics: The confirmation must reach assistive technology through a live region, not colour alone
components.crystal: Material, the confirmation transition and its timing
components.product: The clipboard call and its failure handling
components.note: The confirmation may show a check mark: it reports a completed action, which is information display.

components.name: Close button
components.anatomy: A compact icon action that dismisses its container.
components.geometry: Pill or circle; 44px minimum target
components.semantics: Accessible name naming what closes, not just "Close"; Escape must do the same thing
components.crystal: Material, geometry, placement within overlays
components.product: What dismissal does and whether it is destructive

components.name: Action bar
components.anatomy: A Resin group of actions that appears when a selection exists.
components.geometry: Pill; floats above content with the floating elevation.
components.semantics: role="toolbar"; announces how many items are selected.
components.crystal: Material, entry and exit motion, elevation
components.product: Which actions apply to a selection

components.name: Speed dial
components.anatomy: A floating action that expands into a small set of related actions.
components.material: Resin trigger and Resin action pills
components.geometry: Circular trigger; actions are pills; 44px minimum throughout.
components.semantics: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded; actions are labelled, never icon-only without a name.
components.crystal: Material, stagger on expansion, geometry
components.product: Which actions appear and what they do

categories.name: Inputs and forms
categories.description: Data entry. Every field keeps a visible label, a circular Resin/Haze state badge, and a focus ring that is never replaced by the badge.

components.name: Text input
components.anatomy: Visible label, Resin field shell with an inset Haze well, the native control, a circular state badge, and helper or error text.
components.material: Resin shell, Haze well; the native field keeps its functional boundary
components.geometry: Field well radius = content radius − 7px; shell 20px; 44px minimum height
components.semantics: Native input with a programmatically associated label, aria-invalid and aria-describedby for errors
components.crystal: Shell material, badge vocabulary (hollow circle idle, filled focused, asterisk required, exclamation invalid), focus ring
components.product: Validation rules, error copy and submission

components.name: Textarea
components.anatomy: Text input anatomy with a multi-line well and an optional resize affordance.
components.geometry: Well radius = content radius − 7px; minimum three visible lines
components.semantics: Native textarea with an associated label; autosize must not trap the caret
components.crystal: Shell material, badge placement at the well's top edge, focus ring
components.product: Autosize policy, character limits and validation

components.name: Number input
components.anatomy: Text input anatomy with increment and decrement controls.
components.material: Resin shell; steppers share the plane rather than floating separately
components.geometry: Stepper targets meet 44px even when visually compact
components.semantics: Native number input or a text input with inputmode and role=spinbutton; arrow keys must step
components.crystal: Shell, stepper treatment, at-bound states
components.product: Step size, precision, clamping and locale formatting

components.name: Password input
components.anatomy: Text input anatomy with a reveal toggle and optional strength meter.
components.material: Resin shell; the toggle shares the shell
components.geometry: Toggle meets the 44px floor
components.semantics: The reveal toggle is a button with aria-pressed and a real accessible name; never a decorative icon
components.crystal: Shell, toggle placement, strength meter treatment
components.product: Strength policy and what it reveals

components.name: Search input
components.anatomy: Text input anatomy with a leading search icon and a clear control.
components.geometry: Pill well is permitted here, as search reads as an action surface
components.semantics: role=searchbox or type=search inside a search landmark; the clear control is a named button
components.crystal: Shell, icon placement, clear affordance, loading treatment
components.product: Debounce, the query and result rendering

components.name: Select
components.anatomy: Labelled Resin shell containing a native select, with the platform disclosure preserved.
components.geometry: Well radius = content radius − 7px
components.semantics: Native select wherever the option set allows it; the badge never covers the platform arrow
components.crystal: Shell material, badge placement clear of the disclosure, focus ring

components.name: Combobox
components.anatomy: A text field with a filtered popover list, keyboard highlight and optional creation.
components.material: Resin field shell, Resin popover with Haze rows
components.geometry: Popover content radius; rows inset 8px
components.semantics: role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the list is never focus-stealing
components.crystal: Field and popover material, row treatment, label weight for selection, empty and loading appearance
components.product: The accessible combobox implementation, filtering and async loading

components.name: Multi select
components.anatomy: Combobox anatomy whose value is a set of removable chips inside the field shell.
components.geometry: Chips are pills; the shell grows in whole line steps
components.semantics: Each chip's remove control is a named button; removal must be reachable by keyboard
components.crystal: Chip geometry within the shell, overflow treatment, growth behaviour
components.product: Selection limits, the option set and the accessible implementation

components.name: Checkbox
components.anatomy: A luminous Resin box with a contained contrast-bearing mark, plus its label.
components.material: Resin box, primary fill when checked
components.geometry: 26px box, 9px radius; the whole label is a target meeting 44px
components.semantics: Native checkbox; indeterminate set through the property, not a class
components.crystal: Box material, the contained mark, focus ring
components.note: The checked mark is a check glyph. That is the control's own semantics — a validated, entered value — not a selection badge placed over a focused item.

components.name: Checkbox group
components.anatomy: A labelled fieldset of related checkboxes with shared helper or error text.
components.geometry: Spacing from the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: fieldset and legend, or role=group with an accessible name; errors describe the group
components.crystal: Grouping rhythm and error association treatment

components.name: Radio
components.anatomy: A circular Resin control with a contained centre mark, plus its label.
components.material: Resin circle, primary centre when selected
components.geometry: 26px circle; label target meets 44px
components.semantics: Native radio in a named group; arrow keys move within the group
components.crystal: Circle material, contained centre mark, focus ring

components.name: Radio group
components.anatomy: A labelled fieldset of mutually exclusive options.
components.geometry: 4px rhythm
components.semantics: fieldset and legend, or role=radiogroup with an accessible name
components.crystal: Grouping rhythm and error association

components.name: Switch
components.anatomy: A Resin track with a contrast-bearing thumb that moves between two ends.
components.material: Resin track, primary-soft track when on, opaque thumb
components.geometry: 44x28px track, circular thumb; 44px target
components.semantics: Native checkbox with role=switch, or a button with aria-checked; state must not rely on position alone
components.crystal: Track and thumb material, travel, focus ring on the track
components.product: What toggling does and whether it is immediate or deferred

components.name: Slider
components.anatomy: A value-driven track with a marked glass thumb, optional ticks and a visible value.
components.material: Primary fill to the value, primary-soft beyond; Resin thumb
components.geometry: 8px track, 26px thumb; the thumb is the target and meets 44px in practice through padding
components.semantics: Native range or role=slider with aria-valuenow, valuemin, valuemax and valuetext
components.crystal: Track fill, thumb material, tick treatment, RTL mirroring
components.product: Step, bounds and what the value drives

components.name: Range slider
components.anatomy: Slider anatomy with two thumbs bounding a filled span.
components.geometry: Shared with Slider; thumbs must remain separable when they meet
components.semantics: Two sliders with distinct accessible names; each announces its own bound
components.crystal: Span fill, thumb collision behaviour
components.product: Minimum span and what the range drives

components.name: Segmented control
components.anatomy: A pill strip of mutually exclusive options sharing one Resin plane.
components.material: One Resin plane; primary fill on the selected segment
components.geometry: Pill strip and pill segments; 44px minimum
components.semantics: Radio group semantics, or aria-pressed on buttons; never aria-selected outside a tablist
components.crystal: Shared plane, label weight for the selected segment, focus ring

components.name: Rating
components.anatomy: An ordered set of symbols expressing a score, with optional fractional fill.
components.material: Primary fill on the active symbols
components.geometry: 24px symbols on the icon grid; 44px targets when interactive
components.semantics: Radio group when interactive; plain text with a visible value when read-only. Never symbol-only.
components.crystal: Symbol treatment and fractional fill
components.product: Scale, precision and what the score means

components.name: PIN input
components.anatomy: A row of single-character Resin wells that advance automatically.
components.geometry: Square-ish wells at the field radius; 44px minimum
components.semantics: One labelled group; paste must fill the whole value; backspace must move back
components.crystal: Well geometry, advance and focus treatment

components.name: Tags input
components.anatomy: A field shell whose value is a set of removable chips created as you type.
components.geometry: Pill chips; shell grows in whole line steps
components.semantics: Each chip has a named remove control; additions and removals are announced
components.crystal: Chip geometry, duplicate and limit treatment

components.name: Chip
components.anatomy: A compact pill representing a value, filter or selection, optionally removable.
components.material: Haze fill on a Resin rim; primary fill when selected
components.geometry: Pill; 32px compact height with a 44px target
components.semantics: Selectable chips use aria-pressed; the remove control is a separate named button
components.crystal: Pill geometry, selected treatment, remove affordance
components.product: What the chip filters or represents

components.name: Colour input
components.anatomy: A field shell with a colour swatch, a text value and an optional picker surface.
components.material: Resin shell; the swatch is specimen content, not a reading well
components.geometry: Circular swatch; picker at content radius
components.semantics: A text value must always be editable; colour alone is never the only representation
components.crystal: Swatch treatment, picker surface material
components.product: Colour space, format and the picker implementation

components.name: Date input
components.anatomy: A field shell with segmented or free-text date entry and a calendar disclosure.
components.geometry: Field radius; calendar at content radius
components.semantics: Typing must always be possible; the calendar is an enhancement, never the only route
components.crystal: Shell, disclosure placement, calendar surface
components.product: Locale, parsing, validation and the calendar implementation

components.name: Date picker
components.anatomy: A calendar surface with month navigation, a day grid and today and selected treatments.
components.material: Resin surface, Haze day cells, primary fill on the selection
components.geometry: Circular day cells; 44px targets
components.semantics: role=grid with full arrow-key navigation; the selected date is announced in words
components.crystal: Surface, cell geometry, selection and range treatment
components.product: Date arithmetic, locale, disabled ranges and the grid keyboard implementation

components.name: Date range picker
components.anatomy: Date picker anatomy with a start, an end and a filled span between them.
components.geometry: Span fill joins cells without breaking the 44px target
components.semantics: Start and end are separately named and separately announced
components.crystal: Span treatment and preview appearance
components.product: Range rules, minimum and maximum spans

components.name: Time input
components.anatomy: A field shell with hour, minute and optional period segments.
components.geometry: Field radius; segment targets meet 44px
components.semantics: Segments are individually focusable and individually announced
components.crystal: Shell and segment treatment

components.name: File input
components.anatomy: A named file action with selected-file rows and per-file removal.
components.geometry: Pill action; rows at content radius
components.semantics: Native file input with a real label; progress and errors reach a live region
components.crystal: Action and row treatment, progress appearance
components.product: Upload, accepted types, size limits and retry
components.note: Crystal supplies appearance only. A file input that does not actually upload must not be presented as working.

components.name: Dropzone
components.anatomy: A bounded region accepting dragged files, with idle, hovering and rejecting states.
components.material: Haze surface with a dashed edge at rest, primary-soft while accepting
components.geometry: Content radius; minimum 120px height
components.semantics: Must have a keyboard-reachable file action; drag and drop is never the only route
components.crystal: Surface, edge treatment and state appearance

components.name: Form field
components.anatomy: The wrapper binding a label, control, helper text and error message together.
components.geometry: Label to control 7px; control to helper 6px
components.semantics: Programmatic association through label, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Errors are text, never colour alone.
components.crystal: Rhythm, label and helper treatment, error appearance
components.product: Validation timing, error copy and submission

components.name: Fieldset
components.anatomy: A named group of related fields with an optional description.
components.material: Optional Haze panel for visually grouped sections
components.geometry: Content radius when a surface is used
components.semantics: Native fieldset and legend; disabling the set disables its controls
components.crystal: Grouping rhythm and optional panel treatment
components.product: Which fields group and cross-field validation

components.name: Transfer
components.anatomy: Two lists with controls that move items between them.
components.material: Haze list panels, Resin move actions
components.geometry: Content radius panels; pill actions
components.semantics: Each list is separately named; moves are announced; keyboard must move items without drag
components.crystal: Panel and action treatment, label weight for selection in the lists
components.product: The data, move rules and filtering

components.name: Cascader
components.anatomy: Progressive columns narrowing a hierarchical selection.
components.geometry: Content radius; columns separated by a hairline
components.semantics: Each column is a listbox; the composed value is announced as a path
components.crystal: Popover and column treatment, label weight for the selected column entry
components.product: The hierarchy, lazy loading and the keyboard implementation

components.name: Mentions
components.anatomy: A text surface that offers a filtered list after a trigger character.
components.material: Resin popover with Haze rows over the field
components.geometry: Popover at content radius, anchored to the caret
components.semantics: Combobox semantics attached to the text surface; the inserted value is announced
components.crystal: Popover, row and inserted-token treatment
components.product: Trigger characters, the data source and insertion

components.name: Rich text surface
components.anatomy: A toolbar of formatting actions above an editable content surface.
components.geometry: Toolbar is a pill group; surface at content radius
components.semantics: Toolbar actions use aria-pressed for active formatting; the editor exposes its own semantics
components.crystal: Toolbar and surface appearance, active-format treatment
components.product: The entire editing engine, serialisation and paste handling
components.note: Crystal specifies the surface only. Do not rebuild a rich-text engine to obtain this appearance.

components.name: Helper text
components.anatomy: Guidance beneath a field, replaced by an error message when the field is invalid.
components.material: None; sits on the surrounding surface
components.geometry: 6px below the control; never overlaps the field shell
components.semantics: Associated through aria-describedby. When an error replaces the hint, the error must also be associated and announced.
components.crystal: Rhythm, colour role, and the transition between hint and error
components.product: The copy and when guidance becomes an error
components.note: Guidance is removed only after the field is complete, and never while the field is focused.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.anatomy: A text field that suggests values as it is typed, allowing free text.
components.material: Haze field fill inside a Resin shell; Frost popover
components.geometry: Field radius is the content radius; the popover keeps panel radius.
components.semantics: combobox with aria-autocomplete="list"; the input keeps its own value.
components.crystal: Materials, focus ring, list motion, empty and loading surfaces
components.product: Where suggestions come from, debounce, free-text policy

components.name: Native select
components.anatomy: A platform select, for cases where the native picker is the right answer.
components.material: Haze field fill inside a Resin shell
components.geometry: Matches the text field; the indicator sits in the trailing inline edge.
components.semantics: A real <select>. Its options are the platform's and are never restyled.
components.crystal: Shell material, focus ring, indicator

components.name: Date and time picker
components.anatomy: One control that resolves both a date and a time.
components.geometry: Segments are individually focusable; the panel keeps panel radius.
components.semantics: Segmented input semantics; each segment announces its own role and bounds.
components.crystal: Materials, segment focus, panel motion
components.product: Locale, time zone, min and max

components.name: Month picker
components.anatomy: A grid of months within a year.

components.name: Mask input

components.name: JSON input

components.name: Colour area

components.name: Colour slider

components.name: Colour wheel

components.name: Colour swatch picker

components.name: Token field

components.name: Upload

components.name: Upload zone

categories.name: Data display
categories.description: Presenting content. These are reading surfaces: Haze fills carry them, text stays crisp, and no fill is ever feathered across a glyph.

components.name: Card
components.anatomy: A Haze content surface with optional media, header, body and action row.
components.material: Haze, 80% fill with a 1.95px feathered perimeter
components.geometry: Content radius; at least 12px between content and the feathered edge
components.semantics: An article when it is content, a button when the whole card acts. Never both.
components.crystal: Fill, feather, elevation, interactive treatment
components.product: Content and what an interactive card does
components.note: A card-shaped button keeps the content radius rather than the action pill, so its artwork is not clipped.

components.name: Table
components.anatomy: A Resin-rimmed shell over Haze, a sticky header band, hairline row separators and a scrolling body.
components.material: Resin shell, Haze fill, primary-soft header
components.geometry: Content radius shell; header corners inset 8px; 14px/18px cells
components.semantics: Real table semantics with header associations; sort controls are buttons carrying aria-sort
components.crystal: Shell, header band, separators, sticky behaviour, reduced-effect fallbacks
components.product: Data, sorting, pagination and selection behaviour

components.name: Data table
components.anatomy: Table anatomy with sorting, filtering, selection, column sizing and pagination.
components.material: Shared with Table; selection uses label weight, not a check badge on the row
components.geometry: Shared with Table
components.semantics: aria-sort on sorted headers; row selection through real checkboxes with names
components.crystal: All Table treatment plus sort, filter and selection appearance
components.product: The data layer, virtualisation, and the sorting and filtering implementation

components.name: List
components.anatomy: Ordered or unordered rows with optional leading media and trailing actions.
components.material: Haze rows on the surrounding surface
components.geometry: Content radius on rows; separators are hairlines
components.semantics: Real list semantics; interactive rows are buttons or links, not clickable divs
components.crystal: Row treatment, separators, label weight for the selected row

components.name: Description list
components.anatomy: Term and value pairs in a two-column or stacked arrangement.
components.geometry: Content radius; term column aligned to the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Real definition-list semantics so term and value stay associated
components.crystal: Pair rhythm and panel treatment

components.name: Avatar
components.anatomy: A circular image, initials or icon, with an optional status indicator.
components.material: Surface-alt fill behind initials; 2px surface ring for separation
components.geometry: Always circular; sizes on the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Decorative avatars are aria-hidden; identifying avatars carry the person's name
components.crystal: Shape, ring, fallback treatment
components.product: Real identity, image loading and the fallback source

components.name: Avatar group
components.anatomy: Overlapping avatars with an overflow count.
components.geometry: -7px overlap; overflow chip matches avatar size
components.semantics: The group has one accessible name; the overflow count is announced, not implied
components.crystal: Overlap, stacking order, overflow treatment
components.product: Who is shown and the overflow threshold

components.name: Badge
components.anatomy: A small count or label attached to a host element.
components.material: Resin shell with Haze fill; status badges use their semantic ink pair
components.geometry: Pill or circle; never smaller than legible
components.semantics: The count reaches assistive technology through the host's accessible name or a live region
components.crystal: Shell, placement, overflow formatting
components.product: The count and when it is meaningful

components.name: Status badge
components.anatomy: A semantic symbol in a circular well, followed by a visible word.
components.material: Tested semantic ink and surface pair behind the symbol; never a coloured perimeter stroke
components.geometry: Pill; 24px symbol well; 36px minimum height
components.semantics: The word carries the meaning. Symbol and colour are reinforcement, never the only signal.
components.crystal: Symbol vocabulary, tested colour pairs, geometry
components.product: Which status applies and the wording
components.note: Success uses a check mark. That is information display — the legitimate use of the glyph.

components.name: Indicator
components.anatomy: A small circular Resin mark attached to a control, carrying state.
components.material: Resin shell with a 3px-inset Haze fill and a 1px feather on that fill
components.geometry: 20px, or 24px on fields; never a click target
components.semantics: aria-hidden. The real control supplies the state; the mark only shows it.
components.crystal: The complete mark vocabulary and its precedence
components.note: Selection resolves to label weight, not a badge. A check mark is not in this vocabulary.

components.name: Image
components.anatomy: Media with a reserved ratio, a loading placeholder and a failure fallback.
components.geometry: Content radius when clipped; never distorts aspect
components.semantics: Meaningful images carry alt text; decorative images carry empty alt
components.crystal: Placeholder, fallback and radius treatment

components.name: Timeline
components.anatomy: Ordered events on a connector with per-event markers.
components.material: Resin markers on a Haze connector
components.geometry: Circular markers; 2px connector
components.semantics: Ordered list; the current item carries aria-current
components.crystal: Marker and connector treatment, state appearance

components.name: Accordion
components.anatomy: Disclosure rows with a header control, a rotating chevron and a content region.
components.material: Haze rows; expanded content shares the row surface
components.geometry: Content radius; header meets 44px
components.semantics: Header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; content is not hidden from search when collapsed unless intended
components.crystal: Row treatment, chevron rotation, expansion appearance
components.product: Single or multiple expansion policy and content

components.name: Collapse
components.anatomy: A height transition revealing or hiding a region.
components.geometry: Inherits
components.semantics: The trigger carries aria-expanded; hidden content is genuinely hidden from assistive technology
components.crystal: Transition timing and reduced-motion behaviour

components.name: Spoiler
components.anatomy: Content truncated to a height with a reveal control and an edge fade.
components.material: Edge fade drawn from the surrounding material
components.geometry: Fade depth 24px
components.semantics: The control carries aria-expanded; truncated text remains in the accessibility tree
components.crystal: Fade and control treatment

components.name: Carousel
components.anatomy: A scrolling track of slides with previous and next controls and position indicators.
components.material: Resin controls floating over Haze slides
components.geometry: Content radius slides; pill controls meeting 44px
components.semantics: role=group with an accessible name; indicators are buttons; never autoplay without a pause control
components.crystal: Slide and control treatment, indicator appearance
components.product: Slides, scroll behaviour and autoplay policy

components.name: Statistic
components.anatomy: A large value with a label and an optional trend indicator.
components.material: Haze panel when grouped into a row
components.geometry: Content radius; tabular figures
components.semantics: Trend direction is stated in text, not by colour or arrow alone
components.crystal: Value typography, trend treatment
components.product: The value, formatting and what the trend compares

components.name: Code
components.anatomy: Inline or block monospace content with an optional copy action.
components.material: Canvas fill with an edge rim; never feathered, as code must stay exact
components.geometry: 14px radius inline, content radius for blocks
components.semantics: Real code and pre elements; blocks are focusable when scrollable
components.crystal: Surface, rhythm and copy-action placement

components.name: Keyboard key
components.anatomy: A small raised key cap representing a physical key.
components.material: Resin cap with a defined lower rim
components.geometry: 8px radius; compact but legible
components.semantics: Real kbd element; key names are spelled, not drawn as symbols alone
components.crystal: Cap treatment

components.name: Theme icon
components.anatomy: An icon in a filled container, used as a visual anchor rather than an action.
components.geometry: Content radius or circle; 24px icon
components.semantics: Decorative and aria-hidden unless it is the only carrier of meaning
components.crystal: Container fill and icon sizing
components.product: Which icon and what it anchors

components.name: Authored bubble
components.anatomy: A reading surface with one intentionally tightened corner indicating authorship or direction.
components.material: Haze; own messages use the primary-container pair
components.geometry: 6/22/22/22px incoming, 22/6/22/22px own, mirrored for right-to-left
components.semantics: Author and time are text, not implied by side alone
components.crystal: Silhouette, corner asymmetry, own and incoming pairs, mirroring
components.product: Delivery, grouping rules and failure recovery
components.note: This silhouette is part of Crystal's identity and carries through from the approved baseline.

components.name: Caption
components.anatomy: Descriptive text accompanying media, placed below or over the media surface.
components.material: Stone label backing when overlaid on media, so contrast does not depend on the image
components.geometry: Content radius when overlaid; 12px inset from the media edge
components.semantics: Real figure and figcaption. A caption never replaces alt text; the two say different things.
components.crystal: Backing material, placement and protected contrast

components.name: Calendar
components.anatomy: A month grid, usable on its own rather than only inside a picker.
components.material: Frost panel with Haze day cells
components.geometry: Cells reach 44px; the panel keeps panel radius.
components.semantics: A grid with row and column headers; today is marked as current, selection as selected.
components.crystal: Cell materials, range rendering, selection by weight

components.name: Data view
components.anatomy: A collection rendered as a list or grid, with sorting and paging.
components.material: Haze item fills on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Item radius is the content radius; layout switches at a declared breakpoint.
components.semantics: A list; the layout switch is a control with a pressed state, not a hidden toggle.
components.crystal: Item material, layout motion, empty and loading surfaces

components.name: Virtual scroller
components.anatomy: A long list that renders only what is near the viewport.
components.geometry: Scroll container follows the scroll-area contract.
components.semantics: Rows keep their position in the set via aria-setsize and aria-posinset.
components.crystal: Scroll surface, focus retention across recycling

components.name: Image list
components.anatomy: A grid of images with optional captions.
components.material: Haze caption bars over the image
components.geometry: Uniform gap; caption bars keep the content radius at the bottom corners.
components.semantics: A list; each image needs an accessible name or is marked decorative.
components.crystal: Caption material, focus ring, aspect handling

components.name: Organization chart
components.anatomy: A hierarchy drawn as connected nodes.
components.material: Haze nodes on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Nodes keep the content radius; connectors use the rim colour.
components.semantics: A tree; collapse state is announced, and the chart is navigable by keyboard.
components.crystal: Node material, connector colour, selection by weight

components.name: Rolling number
components.anatomy: A number that animates digit by digit when it changes.
components.geometry: Tabular figures so the width does not jump.
components.semantics: The value is announced once it settles, not on every frame.
components.crystal: Digit motion, reduced-motion fallback to an instant change

components.name: Image compare
components.anatomy: Two images under a draggable divider.
components.geometry: Handle is a pill and reaches 44px.
components.semantics: The divider is a slider with a percentage value and keyboard steps.
components.crystal: Handle material, focus ring, drag motion
components.product: The two images and their labels

components.name: Marquee
components.anatomy: Content that scrolls continuously along one axis.
components.geometry: Edges fade using the surrounding material, not a hard cut.
components.semantics: Pausable on hover and focus; removed entirely under reduced motion.
components.crystal: Edge treatment, motion, the reduced-motion contract

components.name: Overlay badge
components.anatomy: A badge positioned over the corner of another element.
components.material: Haze fill with a crisp glyph
components.geometry: Offset from the corner; never clipped by its host.
components.semantics: Labels its host rather than standing alone; decorative badges are hidden from assistive technology.
components.crystal: Material, offset, glyph crispness

components.name: Navigation tree
components.anatomy: A tree whose items are navigation destinations rather than data.
components.geometry: Indentation per level; rows reach 44px.
components.semantics: A tree with aria-current on the active destination; expansion is announced.
components.crystal: Row material, expansion motion, current marking by label weight

components.name: Resizable table
components.anatomy: A table whose columns can be resized by pointer and keyboard.
components.geometry: The resizer is a 44px target that does not shift the column it borders.
components.semantics: The resizer is a slider: arrow keys resize, and the new width is announced.
components.crystal: Resizer affordance, focus ring, live layout while dragging

components.name: Stat card
components.anatomy: A single figure with its label, trend and period.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: The figure and its trend are one readable sentence, not a number beside an arrow.
components.crystal: Material, figure typography, trend colour from the status tokens

components.name: KPI tile
components.anatomy: A stat card with a target and progress toward it.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Target attainment is stated in words as well as shown.
components.crystal: Material, progress rendering, status colour

components.name: Trend indicator
components.anatomy: Direction and magnitude of a change.
components.geometry: Sits inline with the figure it qualifies.
components.semantics: Direction is carried by a word and a symbol, never by colour alone.
components.crystal: Status colour, symbol pairing
components.product: What counts as a meaningful change

components.name: Delta badge
components.anatomy: A compact signed change.
components.geometry: Pill.
components.semantics: The sign is a character, not a colour.
components.crystal: Status tokens, pill geometry

categories.name: Feedback and status
categories.description: Telling people what happened and what is happening. Every state here is carried by words first; symbol and colour reinforce.

components.name: Alert
components.anatomy: An inline banner with a semantic symbol, a title, body text and optional actions.
components.material: Haze surface with the semantic ink pair on the symbol well
components.geometry: Content radius; 12px minimum from content to the feathered edge
components.semantics: role=alert only for genuinely urgent, interrupting content; otherwise a plain region
components.crystal: Surface, symbol well, semantic pairs, action placement
components.product: The message, severity and any recovery action

components.name: Toast
components.anatomy: A transient floating Resin notification with a message and an optional single action.
components.material: Resin with Haze reading fill and the clearest floating shadow
components.geometry: Content radius; stacked with a 12px offset
components.semantics: Polite live region; an urgent toast is assertive. Auto-dismiss must never remove the only route to an action.
components.crystal: Surface, stacking, entry and exit motion
components.product: Message, duration policy, queueing and the action

components.name: Notification
components.anatomy: A persistent, dismissible message with a title, body, timestamp and actions.
components.material: Resin surface with Haze reading fill
components.geometry: Content radius
components.semantics: Announced politely; the dismiss control is named for what it dismisses
components.crystal: Surface, unread treatment, action row

components.name: Progress
components.anatomy: A determinate or indeterminate track showing work in flight.
components.material: Primary fill on a primary-soft track
components.geometry: 8px track at pill radius, matching the slider track
components.semantics: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow when determinate; indeterminate omits the value rather than faking one
components.crystal: Track, fill, indeterminate motion and reduced-motion fallback
components.product: Real progress. Never simulate progress for work that is not measurable.

components.name: Ring progress
components.anatomy: A circular track with a filled arc and an optional centre label.
components.material: Primary arc on a primary-soft ring
components.geometry: Stroke matches the icon stroke weight family; label is tabular
components.semantics: Shared with Progress; the centre label is not the only representation
components.crystal: Ring, arc, label treatment

components.name: Loader
components.anatomy: A compact indeterminate activity mark.
components.geometry: Sizes on the 4px rhythm
components.semantics: Accompanied by text saying what is loading; reduced motion replaces spin with a static, still-legible state
components.crystal: Mark, motion and reduced-motion fallback
components.product: When it appears and what it describes

components.name: Skeleton
components.anatomy: Placeholder shapes matching the layout of content that is loading.
components.material: Haze fill with a slow luminance sweep
components.geometry: Matches the real content's radius and rhythm exactly
components.semantics: aria-hidden with a live region announcing loading; must not be read as content
components.crystal: Fill, sweep, reduced-motion fallback, resolve transition
components.note: A skeleton must match the real layout. A skeleton that does not resolve into the shape it promised is a worse experience than a spinner.

components.name: Loading overlay
components.anatomy: A scrim over a region with a centred activity mark, blocking interaction.
components.geometry: Inherits the region's radius
components.semantics: Blocked content is inert; focus does not enter it; the reason is announced
components.crystal: Scrim, mark placement, inert treatment
components.product: When the region blocks and for how long

components.name: Empty state
components.anatomy: An explanation of why a region is empty, with the action that would fill it.
components.geometry: Content radius; centred within its region
components.semantics: Real text; never an illustration alone. No-results and truly-empty are different states and read differently.
components.crystal: Panel, rhythm and action placement

components.name: Result
components.anatomy: A full-region outcome with a status symbol, title, explanation and next actions.
components.material: Haze panel with the semantic ink pair on the symbol
components.geometry: Content radius
components.semantics: The outcome is stated in the heading; symbol and colour reinforce it
components.crystal: Panel, symbol treatment, action row
components.product: The outcome, explanation and recovery routes

components.name: Inline confirm
components.anatomy: A small popover asking for confirmation next to the control that triggered it.
components.material: Resin popover with Haze reading fill
components.geometry: Content radius; anchored to the trigger
components.semantics: Focus moves into the popover, returns to the trigger on dismiss, and Escape cancels
components.crystal: Popover surface and action row
components.product: The consequence, its wording and whether a full dialog is warranted instead
components.note: Consequential and irreversible actions belong in a dialog, not an inline confirm.

components.name: Tour
components.anatomy: A sequence of steps that points at parts of the interface.
components.material: Frost step panel over a Mirage scrim
components.geometry: Panel keeps panel radius; the highlight follows the target's own radius.
components.semantics: Focus moves to each step; the sequence is escapable and its position is announced.
components.crystal: Panel and scrim material, step motion, focus management

components.name: Semi-circle progress
components.anatomy: A half-ring showing progress toward a value.
components.material: Haze track with a primary arc
components.geometry: Stroke matches the ring progress contract.
components.semantics: role="progressbar" with a text value beside it.
components.crystal: Arc rendering, track material, motion

components.name: Meter group
components.anatomy: Several proportions shown on one bar.
components.geometry: Track keeps the content radius; segments meet without gaps.
components.semantics: Each segment is labelled; meaning never rests on colour alone.
components.crystal: Track and segment materials, legend, label association

components.name: Banner
components.anatomy: A full-width message pinned to the top of a region.
components.material: Haze fill with a status accent
components.geometry: Full-bleed within its region; the dismiss control is a 44px pill.
components.semantics: role="status" for information, role="alert" for urgency. Dismissal returns focus sensibly.
components.crystal: Material, status colour from the status tokens, entry and exit motion
components.product: Copy, urgency, and whether it persists

categories.name: Overlays
categories.description: Surfaces that sit above the scene. Crystal supplies the material and the separation; the product supplies real modality, focus containment and focus return.

components.name: Dialog
components.anatomy: A Mirage scrim, a Haze decision surface, a title, body and named actions.
components.material: Mirage scrim; 80% feathered Haze surface above it
components.geometry: Content radius; 12px minimum from content to the feathered edge
components.semantics: Real modal semantics with a named dialog, focus containment, Escape, and focus return to the trigger
components.crystal: Scrim, surface, entrance and exit motion, elevation
components.product: Modality, focus management, the decision itself and its consequences

components.name: Drawer
components.anatomy: An edge-anchored panel over a Mirage scrim, with a label and a close control.
components.material: Mirage scrim, Frost or Resin panel by depth
components.geometry: Panel radius on the inner edges only
components.semantics: Dialog semantics when modal; a complementary region when not. Modality must be real, not implied.
components.crystal: Panel material, edge geometry, entrance direction

components.name: Menu
components.anatomy: A Resin popover of actions, with optional groups, separators and checkable items.

components.crystal: Surface, row treatment, row geometry, separators
components.product: The menu implementation, actions and dismissal

components.name: Context menu
components.anatomy: Menu anatomy opened at a pointer position or from a keyboard context key.
components.geometry: Repositions to stay within the viewport
components.semantics: Must be reachable by keyboard, not pointer-only; never the sole route to an action
components.crystal: Surface and positioning behaviour
components.product: The actions and the keyboard route

components.name: Popover
components.anatomy: An anchored Resin surface holding arbitrary content, with optional arrow.
components.geometry: Content radius; flips and shifts to stay in view
components.semantics: The trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls; focus moves in for interactive content
components.crystal: Surface, arrow, positioning behaviour

components.name: Hover card
components.anatomy: A popover that opens on hover or focus after a delay, showing preview content.
components.geometry: Shared with Popover
components.semantics: Must also open on keyboard focus; never contains the only route to an action
components.crystal: Surface, open and close delays

components.name: Tooltip
components.anatomy: Short supplemental text on a small Resin surface, anchored to its trigger.
components.geometry: 18px radius; compact padding
components.semantics: Never the sole accessible name. Opens on focus as well as hover, dismisses on Escape, and stays while hovered.
components.crystal: Surface, delay, placement
components.product: Content and whether a tooltip is the right disclosure at all

components.name: Scrim
components.anatomy: The Mirage layer separating an overlay from the scene beneath it.

components.crystal: The complete Mirage recipe and its reduced-transparency fallback
components.product: Inertness, dismissal policy and stack order

components.name: Portal
components.anatomy: A mechanism for rendering an overlay outside its layout parent.
components.geometry: None
components.semantics: Portalled content must preserve the logical focus and reading order of its trigger
components.crystal: Stacking contract and layer placement

components.name: Floating window
components.anatomy: A draggable, resizable panel that stays within the viewport.
components.geometry: Panel radius; the resize handle reaches 44px.
components.semantics: role="dialog" when modal-like; focus is trapped only when it is modal.

components.name: Overlay arrow
components.anatomy: The pointer that ties a popover or tooltip to its trigger.
components.geometry: Follows the overlay radius; flips with placement.
components.semantics: Decorative: hidden from assistive technology.

categories.name: Typography
categories.description: Reading. Reading text stays 16px/24px on every platform, and text scaling always takes precedence over layout.

components.name: Title

components.semantics: The visual level must not be chosen independently of the document outline; use a level, style separately
components.crystal: Scale, tracking and leading

components.name: Text

categories.name: Blocks
categories.description: Composed arrangements that solve a recognisable product problem: a dashboard shell, a checkout, a player, a storefront. Kept as their own tier rather than mixed into the components, because a component is a primitive with one job and a contract, while a block is opinionated by design — and a design system that cannot tell the two apart ships opinions as if they were primitives. Benchmarked against Tailwind UI, Mantine UI, Ant Design Pro, MUI Templates and PrimeBlocks.
